赵干事他们一行三人一回到旗里边，车还没停稳，他就跳了下来。

“你们俩把东西搬下来，小心点，别磕着！”赵干事交代了一句，转身就大步流星地往办公楼里走。他手里攥着那张图纸——王建新画的那张，叠得方方正正的，揣在怀里一路没松手。

办公楼不大，两层小楼当年苏联援建的，门口挂着块木牌子。赵干事三步并作两步上了二楼，推开一间办公室的门，气喘吁吁地喊道：“好消息啊，书记，你看看这是什么？”

书记叫刘建国，五十来岁，穿着中山装，稳稳当当地坐在办公桌后面。脸也是黑红黑红的——这地方风大，太阳毒，谁也逃不掉。他扶了扶眼镜，不急不慢地接过赵干事递来的图纸，展开来，眯着眼看了半天。

图纸画得很精细，尺寸标得清清楚楚，部件名称写得明明白白。刘书记看了一会儿，抬起头，好奇地问道：“这是哪来的？这好像是播种机，是吗？”

“对！”赵干事赶忙应道，“这是一个小知青设计的手推播种机，效果特别好，我试过了！”

刘书记一听，直接站起身：“有样品？”

“有！拉回来了，在车上！”

“快带我看看。”

刘书记抓起桌上的帽子，扣在头上，大步往外走。赵干事跟在后面，一边走一边说：“书记，你是没看见，那东西虽然做得糙，但真管用。推着走一圈，开沟、下种、覆土、镇压，一次完成。两亩地不到一个小时就种完了，我跟你说，一点都不夸张……”

两人来到院子里，司机和小同志已经小心翼翼地把手推播种机从卡车上卸了下来。两个人一人抬一头，轻拿轻放，像捧着一个珍贵的宝贝，就怕磕着碰着。

刘书记赶忙走到这台播种机跟前，蹲下来，上上下下、左左右右地看了个遍。

木头做的，歪歪扭扭的，没上漆，木板也没刨平，有的地方还露着钉子帽。种箱是用几块木板钉在一起的，缝隙里还嵌着木屑。轮子是用厚木板锯成的，圆不圆方不方的，但转起来还算顺溜。排种轮上的孔洞大大小小的，一看就是手工钻的，毛糙得很。

但刘书记一点也不嫌弃。他伸手摸了摸，拍了拍，又摇了摇扶手，试了试结实程度。然后站起来，对赵干事说：“演示一下。”

赵干事领悟，马上扶起手推播种机，开始为书记讲解。

“这是种箱，装种子的。这是排种轮，种子从这里面掉下去。这是开沟器，在土里开沟。这是覆土板，把土推回去盖上种子。这是镇压轮，把土压实。”赵干事一边指着一边说，又把轮子转了几圈，“轮子一转，排种轮就跟着转，种子就均匀地播下去了。”

刘书记点了点头，示意赵干事推着走几步。

院子里不是耕地，土被踩得硬邦邦的，推不动。赵干事使劲推了几下，开沟器只是在土面上划出几道浅痕，种子也没掉下来——种箱里没装种子。但大体的意思书记已经明白了，开沟器的角度、覆土板的形状、镇压轮的位置，都能看出来是经过设计的，不是瞎糊弄的。

“走，去地里试试。”刘书记一挥手。

大家七手八脚地抬起手推播种机，来到门口的地里边。旗政府门口就是田地，现在也开始播种了，地已经翻过了，土质松软，正合适。

赵干事喊来牧民兄弟，让他从仓库里拿点种子过来。牧民跑着去了，不一会端着一盆麦种回来了。赵干事把种子倒进种箱里，拍了拍手，然后推着播种机来到一块还没开始播种的地里。

“看好了啊。”赵干事双手握住扶手，往前一推。

轮子转动起来，咯咯吱吱地响。开沟器在土里划出四道浅浅的沟，种子从排种轮里掉下去，落在沟里，覆土板把土推回去盖上，镇压轮压过，土面平平整整的。四行，整整齐齐，一眼望过去，间距均匀，深浅一致。

赵干事越推越顺手，越走越快，在地里走了一个来回又一个来回。不到半个小时，一大片地就种完了。他停下来说：“书记，你看。”

刘书记早就蹲在地头了。他扒开土看了看，种子埋得深浅刚好，又顺着垄沟走了几步，种子的间距均匀，没有漏播的地方。他站起来，脸上全是笑，嘴里一直念叨着：“好、好、好啊！”

那个送种子的牧民也看呆了。他接过赵干事手中的手推播种机，翻来覆去地看了几遍，又蹲下来扒开土看了看播下去的效果，两眼放光。

“让我试试！”牧民不等赵干事答应，就往种箱里又续了些种子，推着播种机就往前走。

一开始有点生疏，走得不直，垄沟弯弯曲曲的。走了几趟就上手了，越走越直，越走越快。他在那块地里来回走了两个多小时，把剩下的地全部种完了。那块地有五十来亩，用了大约四个小时左右。

大家站在地头看着，激动得不行。

“这个工具太好用了！”那个牧民推着播种机走回来，脸上全是汗，但笑得合不拢嘴，“我活了四十多年，种了半辈子地，头一回见这么好用的东西！以前种地，弯着腰撒种子，撒一天腰都直不起来，还撒不均匀。这个推着走就行了，不累，还快！”

As soon as Director Zhao and the other three returned to the flag, he jumped out before the car stopped.

"You two move the things down, be careful, don't knock them!" Director Zhao explained, turned around and strode towards the office building.He was holding the drawing in his hand - the one drawn by Wang Jianxin. It was folded squarely and he kept it in his arms without letting go.

The office building is not big. It is a two-story building that was built with Soviet aid. There is a wooden sign hanging at the door.Director Zhao took three steps at a time and climbed up to the second floor. He pushed open the door of an office and shouted breathlessly: "Good news, Secretary, look at what this is?"

The secretary's name is Liu Jianguo. He is in his fifties, wearing a Chinese tunic suit and sitting steadily behind his desk.His face was also black and red—it was very windy here and the sun was poisonous, and no one could escape.He adjusted his glasses, took the drawing handed to him by Director Zhao unhurriedly, unfolded it, and squinted at it for a long time.

The drawings are very detailed, the dimensions are clearly marked, and the names of the components are clearly written.Secretary Liu looked at it for a while, raised his head, and asked curiously: "Where does this come from? This seems to be a seeder, right?"

"Yes!" Director Zhao responded quickly, "This is a hand-push seeder designed by a young educated youth. The effect is particularly good. I have tried it!"

Upon hearing this, Secretary Liu stood up and asked, "Do you have a sample?"

"Yes! He's back, in the car!"

"Show me quickly."

Secretary Liu grabbed the hat on the table, put it on his head, and strode out.Director Zhao followed behind and said as he walked: "Secretary, you haven't seen it. Although that thing is made crudely, it really works. Push it in a circle, dig trenches, plant seeds, cover soil, and suppress it all at once. Two acres of land were planted in less than an hour. Let me tell you, it is not an exaggeration at all..."

The two came to the yard. The driver and the young comrade had carefully unloaded the push seeder from the truck.Each of the two people raised their heads and held it gently, as if they were holding a precious treasure, just to avoid bumping into each other.

Secretary Liu hurriedly walked to the seeder, squatted down, and looked up and down, left and right.

It was made of wood, crooked, unpainted, and the boards were not planed, and the nail caps were still exposed in some places.The seed box is made of several wooden boards nailed together, with sawdust embedded in the gaps.The wheels were sawn from thick wooden boards. They were not round but square, but they turned fairly smoothly.The holes on the seeding wheel are large and small, and it looks like they were drilled by hand, and they are very rough.

But Secretary Liu didn’t dislike it at all.He reached out and touched it, patted it, and shook the armrest to test its firmness.Then he stood up and said to Director Zhao: "Demonstrate."

Director Zhao understood, immediately held up the hand push seeder and began to explain to the secretary.

"This is the seed box, which holds the seeds. This is the seeding wheel, from which the seeds fall. This is the trencher, which makes trenches in the soil. This is the earth-covering board, which pushes the soil back to cover the seeds. This is the suppressing wheel, which compacts the soil." Director Zhao pointed and said, turning the wheel a few more times. "As soon as the wheel turns, the seeding wheel will also rotate, and the seeds will be sown evenly."

Secretary Liu nodded and motioned to Director Zhao to push him a few steps.

The yard was not cultivated land, and the soil was so hard that it could not be pushed.Director Zhao pushed hard a few times, and the trench opener only made a few shallow marks on the soil surface, but the seeds did not fall out - there were no seeds in the seed box.But the secretary already understood the general meaning. The angle of the trencher, the shape of the earth covering plate, and the position of the suppression wheel could all be seen to be designed and not fooled around.

"Let's go and try the fields." Secretary Liu waved his hand.

Everyone scrambled to lift the hand push seeder and came to the field at the door.There is a field right in front of the banner government, and sowing has begun now. The ground has been plowed, and the soil is soft and suitable.

Director Zhao called the herdsmen brother and asked him to get some seeds from the warehouse.The herdsman ran away and came back after a while carrying a pot of wheat seeds.Director Zhao poured the seeds into the seed box, clapped his hands, and then pushed the seeder to a field that had not yet started sowing.

"Watch it." Director Zhao held the armrests with both hands and pushed forward.

The wheels turned and creaked.The trencher draws four shallow trenches in the soil. The seeds fall from the seeding wheel and fall into the trench. The earth-covering board pushes the soil back to cover it. The compactor wheel passes over it, leaving the soil flat and smooth.Four rows, neat and tidy, at a glance, evenly spaced and consistent in depth.

Officer Zhao pushed more and more smoothly, and walked faster and faster, walking back and forth in the field.In less than half an hour, a large area of ​​land was planted.He stopped and said, "Secretary, look."

Secretary Liu has been squatting on the ground for a long time.He dug up the soil and took a look. The seeds were buried at just the right depth. He then walked a few steps along the furrow. The seeds were evenly spaced and there were no missed spots.He stood up with a smile on his face and kept chanting: "Okay, okay, okay!"

The herdsman who sent the seeds was also stunned.He took the hand-push seeder from Director Zhao's hand, looked at it over and over again, squatted down and dug up the soil to see the effect of sowing, his eyes lit up.

"Let me try!" The herder didn't wait for Director Zhao to agree, then added some more seeds to the seed box and pushed the seeder forward.

It was a bit unfamiliar at first, the walking was not straight and the furrows were winding.I got used to it after walking a few times. The straighter I walked, the faster I walked.He walked back and forth in that field for more than two hours and planted all the remaining land.The land was about fifty acres, and it took about four hours.

Everyone stood on the ground and watched, extremely excited.

"This tool is so useful!" The herdsman came back pushing the seeder, his face covered with sweat, but he was smiling from ear to ear. "I have lived for more than 40 years and have been farming for half my life. This is the first time I have seen such a useful tool! In the past, I had to bend over to spread seeds. I couldn't straighten my waist after a day of spreading, and the seeds were spread unevenly. This is just a push, it's not tiring, and it's fast!"
